tagline: 美能达便携相机，1993 年发布
description: 美能达于1993年推出的便携相机。配备30 mm f/4,5.。使用Automatic loading, advance and rewind.。感光度Crippled DX decoding; films below ISO 400 are exposed as ISO 100, those above as ISO 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Active infrared autofocus from 1,1 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus from 1,1 m to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, auto-activated, non-cancellable with optional anti-red eye mode. Range: 1,1–3,5 m. Flash ready LED signal.
specs.感光度: Crippled DX decoding; films below ISO 400 are exposed as ISO 100, those above as ISO 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Riva AF 35 EX, or Freedom AF 10R in America, is a cheap autofocus compact camera released in 1993 as a follow-up to the Riva 35c.
